changes: net: dsa: treat deleting an absent host FDB entry as success, stopping the mt7530 "failed to delete ... from fdb: -2" spam caused by station-removal FDB notifications.

Default the syslog ring to 1024 KiB when unset or stock 128, and add a passive procd watchdog that saves one bounded, rate-limited snapshot to /tmp on the all-band deauth outage signature without restarting Wi-Fi.

Board LuCI apps: remove root code execution paths (netspeedtest arch/sed, flowsense awk), drop the /dev/mem ACL, cap the NPU PLL at the stock 1200 MHz with overflow-safe validation, keep the fan out of stuck manual mode, and give luci-app-wifi7 its own ACL group without exec in the read scope (F01).
Render UCI, runtime and GitHub strings as text in the wifi7, MLO, fan, FlowSense and attendedsysupgrade views (XSS), and keep backend JSON well formed.

luci-app-wifi7: stop restarting Wi-Fi after failed UCI writes (F05), edit the profile the page shows (F07), use the netdev netifd created (F08), restore the saved profile on Discard; luci-app-mlo: allow saving a disabled MLO profile (F06).

Standard Network > Wireless page guards multi-radio MLO sections (LuCI feed patch 0004) and no longer fails with a TypeError when a disabled section has a one-element device list (luci-base feed patch 0006).
sysupgrade on gemtek,w1700k-ubi checks FIT hashes and the UBI2 FIT layout (w1700k-fit-check) and refuses mismatching images even with -F.
GitHub updater: release source VultaV/OpenW1700k, SHA256SUMS, keep-settings honoured, and jq checks without the regex builtins the image jq lacks.
Images ship no remote apk feed; ca-certificates no longer duplicates roots on rebuilds; the r43 single-wiphy channel analysis patch is kept in the repository.
distfeeds.list lists the snapshot base, packages, luci and routing feeds (not target or kmods); 99-w1700k-apk-pin pins every image package to its image version at first boot.
net.core.rmem_default=1048576 so dnsmasq no longer drops bursts of DNS queries.

Kernel 6.18.44 -> 6.18.55: upstream stable updates, patches merged upstream dropped, generic/airoha patches refreshed from upstream OpenWrt, fork bridge offload (675-02/03) and 992-20 rebased, 9999-z3 dropped (in 6.18.55).
mt76 0038 per-link ps_transitions diagnostic counter.

airoha 999-dsa-01: MT7531 netlink PHY read/write errors are returned as netlink errors instead of being reported as success; 992-21: the NPU BA reserved-memory command goes through the same retry helper as the other reserved-memory commands.
mt76 0011: restore the cached txpower when the SKU MCU update fails so the next identical request is retried; 0006: rate-limited log when an NPU RX descriptor advertises more frames than are queued.
w1700k-wifi-watchdog keeps its state and lock under /var/run instead of sticky /tmp.

Board LuCI apps: FlowSense rpcd backend, jitter daemon and airtime state write through mktemp+rename; NPU PLL setter reports failed devmem writes; wifi7 OWE/OWE-transition profiles save without a key and Collect logs runs dmesg/logread through the ACL; fancontrol preset preview updates; netspeedtest result link regex anchored.

mt76 0039: mt7996_get_txpower() resolves the phy by link_id, so iw and LuCI report each MLD link's own txpower instead of the default link's (5 GHz showed the 6 GHz 18 dBm limit while running at 23 dBm). kmod-mt76 r35.
mt76 01367e60 -> 639e1287 (2026-10-08): 90 upstream commits incl. MLO station link, scan and NPU BA timer fixes; fork patches rebased, 0030/0031/0035 dropped as fixed upstream.
wifi-scripts: a 0 dBm txpower setting is applied instead of being treated as auto (upstream 5ee6f1fdbe).
kernel: backport mt7530 VLAN fixes from v7.1 (CPU port VLAN reset to unaware, untag VLAN-aware bridge PVID; upstream 3a985c7398).

airoha: upstream airoha_eth backports (RX ring sizes, PPE flush error handling, QDMA trtcm retry, BQL on the shared TX ring, frag DMA mapping, max receive size, MIB/ETS stats, on-demand GDM3/GDM4 QoS, LRO v7); 992-20 and keep-ttl rebased, 9990 and 9999-z5 dropped as superseded.
Winbond W25N04LV SPI-NAND support (kernel and U-Boot) for hardware revisions with that flash.

hostapd, wifi-scripts, netifd, ubus, ucode, mac80211 (backports 7.2 patches), nftables and libnftnl follow upstream main; hostapd 999-preserve-link-id and 9999-reset-expired-mld dropped (upstream 185 and 181).
kernel: flowtable out ifindex falls back to the dst device when the forward path is unknown (upstream aa9479b02e); SPI-NAND QE bit fix (upstream d42c59d039).
bridge-flow-offload r4: refresh after a recreated port (wifi reload) joins the bridge.

ucode follows upstream main (2026-10-18, upstream a4e922953c): use-after-free fixes in json, zlib, gc sweep and poll/filter value anchoring, ubus deferred reply leak; the rtnl ACK fix is now in the ucode source. uhttpd follows upstream (2026-08-24, Basic Auth realm enforcement for URL-prefix handlers); uhttpd and rpcd handle the new STATUS_BREAK; every ucode consumer rebuilt against the new headers.
status: ucode update candidate on r54; built, not installed.
validation_scope: Snapshot at image build time; later device validation is recorded separately.
